steps.message: Quick one-liner: bump the session timeout from 30 minutes to 8 hours in config.js. Just change the value, nothing fancy.

arguments.command: sed -i '' 's/SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 30,/SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 480,/' config.js && grep -n SESSION config.js; grep -rn "SESSION_TIMEOUT" . --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git

results.content:
3:  SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 480,
config.js:3:  SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 480,
server.js:2:// Minimal stand-in server: sessions expire after SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES.
server.js:3:console.log(`session timeout: ${config.SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES}m`);

steps.message:
I changed `SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES` from `30` to `480` in `config.js:3`. The setting is in minutes, so 480 is 8 hours.

The only other place that uses it is `server.js`, which just prints it at startup and will now show `session timeout: 480m`. I haven't committed the change.
